title: Saravanan Irukka Bayamaen
desc: Saravanan, a lackadaisical young man, stumbles into power as the local political head. Subsequently, armed with clueless confidence, he uses his new role to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Comali
desc: A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.

title: Lucky The Superstar
desc: Lucky, an exceptional and lost puppy, changes the lives of everyone she meets. Finally, she captures the interest of influential political forces, resulting in amusing mayhem and unforeseen upheaval.

title: Good Night
desc: Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

title: Viruman
desc: Viruman is a young man who watches his mother immolate herself. As a result, he distances himself from his father and vows to avenge her death.

title: Asuran
desc: A farmer goes on the run with his family as he is compelled to protect his son, who has murdered a wealthy upper-caste landlord in a fit of vengeance.

title: Nagaram Marupakkam
desc: Selvam, a criminal seeking a fresh start in Hyderabad, falls for a dancer. Just as they plan their future, unresolved events from his past resurface, threatening his new life.

title: Inidhu Inidhu
desc: Freshmen at an engineering college bond after being picked on by seniors, eventually pairing into couples over their four years at school.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Vaangga Mappaley Vaanga
desc: A fun-loving young man, meets a stubborn woman at a wedding and falls in love with her. However, the couple has to bring their feuding families together in order to be with each other.

title: Sivakumarin Sabadham
desc: A man belongs to a weaver's family and strives to overcome multiple challenges in order to make his dreams come true of setting up a textile company.

title: Takkar
desc: A man who wants to be a millionaire meets a woman with a distaste for money. Their chance encounter, however, leads to an unexpected adventure.

title: Raatchasi
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Geetha Rani implements different plans to reform an undisciplined government school. However, she faces numerous challenges in her way, including a corrupt MLA.

title: Kalavani
desc: Arivazhagan, a mischievous young man, falls in love with Maheshwari, who belongs to the rival village. He abducts her and marries her after she confesses her feelings for him.

title: Race Gurram
desc: In an attempt to put an end to the schemes of their enemy, two brothers join forces and stop at nothing to destroy the reign of a gangster who aspires to be a politician.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.
